title: AhsayCBS: 2 flaws used in attacks; attackers can get in without a password
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 35 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. Ready-made attack tools are public. The severity score is critical (10.0). The exploit prediction score is 84%.

category.label: Servers and backups
category.why: It runs or protects many systems at once, including your backups.
category.doThis: Patch it and keep its admin access off the internet.

summary: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Oct 17, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
